400 Bad Request when creating a batch with invalid input file

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    try {
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"completion_window\":\"24h\",\"endpoint\":\"/v1/chat/completions\",\"input_file_id\":\"file-wrong-purpose\"}", CreateBatchRequest::class.java)
    val apiKey = requireNotNull(System.getenv("API_KEY")) { "API_KEY must be set" }
    val result = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey = apiKey).use { client -> client.createBatch(req) }
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
